verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page documents account deletion at any time from the Settings dashboard. It also documents a Privacy Mode, available to any user or enforced by team admins, under which Cursor will not train on user data. Both are Cursor-wide controls rather than Bugbot-specific, and Privacy Mode only governs training use, not how long data is retained. missing for 10: configurable retention periods or zero-retention guarantees, Bugbot-specific deletion of review data and PR context, granular per-item deletion, independent or hands-on corroboration.
